correctness.rationale: Equality of complete belief rows partitions the n states intrinsically. Harsanyi positive-support confinement forces each block to carry a probability vector on its own states; disjoint supports make partition components unique even with zero probabilities. Each component is a product of simplices, of dimension n-number_of_blocks, separated compactly from other components. Stars and bars per block, labeled exponential formula, weight-multiset classification under simultaneous permutations, and degree comparison prove all counting formulas and the d^{-(n-1)^2} rarity exponent. Direct independent grid brute force confirmed n=1..4, d=1..3 counts (1,1,1), (3,4,5), (10,16,23), (41,80,133). A three-state stochastic-idempotent K not Harsanyi separates the stronger condition. Universal formulas are mathematically derived, not extrapolated from this brute test.
